plan.question: Work through your checklist for this paper: Abstract vs results vs tables vs captions: every number, rounding, N, replicates.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Every claim has evidence of matching strength; no overclaiming.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Everything in results is described in methods with identical parameters, datasets, splits.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Symbols defined once and used consistently; derivations continuous; units/dimensions.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Tests, CIs, seeds, effect sizes, multiple comparisons, small-N scoping.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Leakage, baselines, ablations, variance, compute parity, benchmark contamination.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Stoichiometry, formulas, masses, characterisation, conditions (only if chemistry content).
Work through your checklist for this paper: Citations support the claims; closest prior art cited and differentiated; missing key work.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Code/data availability, versions, hyperparameters, seeds, hardware, energy.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Captions self-contained, axes/units, values in figures match text, required plots present.
Work through your checklist for this paper: Human and AI readability: narrative arc, signposting, chunk autonomy, jargon.
